en: The image shows a sepia-toned view from a high vantage point, overlooking a European city with a river running through it. In the foreground, part of a large clock face is visible on a stone wall, along with a stone crest featuring a crowned lion rampant. The background reveals rooftops, a church tower with a bulbous dome, and bridges crossing the river. The architectural style and heraldic crest suggest a historical European city.
